name: ask
description: Asks the person you work for one to four questions, as a card with options; your turn ends there and their answer comes back as this tool's result, maybe much later. They can always write their own answer instead. Ask only when the answer changes what you build and a wrong guess would be costly to undo: how the request splits into parts, which existing thing to reuse, what a learner actually does, the devices it must run on, which idea something depends on. Never ask about looks or wording: build your best guess and let the preview speak, which is the cheaper question. Never ask in technical terms (files, gestalts, schemas, components): ask about the learners and the subject, in the person's language. Mark an option recommended only when you can say why, in its description. One card per turn, and rarely more than one at the start of a draft. Everything you can decide sensibly yourself, decide.

question.description: The whole question, ending with a question mark.

header.description: A very short label for it, up to 12 characters.

multiSelect.description: Whether more than one option may be chosen.

recommended.description: Your recommendation, with the reason in its description.

preview.description: Optional: a short sketch (text) of what it would look like.
